items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Rockefeller' in the context of voting and traveling, but the interviewee (J.C. Higginbotham) does not respond to or acknowledge this mention, nor does he mention Rockefeller in his own turns.

ctx.x: When you came back after your first visit to Europe ...

You know, that's the first time he ever voted. That's when Rockefeller first went in. I took him to the voting place myself. That's the first time he ever voted, he said, in his life, first time. You know I always vote. We went across the street and we voted. After he got off the boat, I waited two and a half hours for this man to get off that boat, 'cause you know they let the first class off first. They were traveling tourist and then the last ones gets off the last. I brought him down, we went to the school…
Tell me, do you remember some of the musicians who traveled with you in Sam Price's band? Who were some of the musicians in the band?
